name: Monterey & Big Sur
about: Summer (Jun–Aug) has the most reliable weather but also the worst Highway 1 traffic; winter storms occasionally close sections of the road through Big Sur entirely.
overview: One of the most scenic coastal drives on Earth through Big Sur, whale watching in Monterey Bay, and Pebble Beach, among the most famous golf courses anywhere.
costOverview: Cannery Row's casual seafood is reasonable — golf at Pebble Beach and Big Sur's clifftop resorts anchor the very top of this range.

specialSeasons.text: Winter storms occasionally trigger landslides that close sections of Highway 1 through Big Sur — check road conditions before a trip.
